generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: an invasive shrub of stiff, upright, green, ridged stems with tiny leaves, bright yellow pea flowers all along them in spring. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: Rough sizes from general knowledge of the species: 2 m tall at 12 years in the open. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye: green stems and tiny leaves; yellow flowers. Fruit (plant roadmap P4), as in mid-July: flat pods 4 to 5 cm long, green ripening black. Its year (appearance.organs.bloom.season) is authored from general knowledge of the species in the south Puget Sound lowlands: yellow flowers in April to June; pods green, black and bursting in July and August. The forest's packages show day 196 (mid-July) until the phenology of plant roadmap P5 sets the day from the date and the local climate.

taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

generator.program.note: The program the spec's authors chose to grow this form.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

sources.title: Project After contributors: hand-set species values

provenance.notes: Procedural proxy from the step-6 catalogue, authored from general knowledge of the species in the south Puget Sound lowlands. Calibration against measurements and photographs is milestone P4.
